1024.unit_of_work: one request, batch1 inclusive consumer prepare/receive/install/bypass first token, ending after device sync
1024.concurrency_assumption: per-request serial envelope; no shared consumer-first-token batch saving modelled

2048.unit_of_work: one request, batch1 inclusive consumer prepare/receive/install/bypass first token, ending after device sync
2048.concurrency_assumption: per-request serial envelope; no shared consumer-first-token batch saving modelled

replacement: Worker replaces layer, norm, RoPE, embedding/head, sampler and prepare fees; receiver replaces legacy bandwidth, install and first-token subfees. No enclosing interval plus subinterval addition.

stages.1_producer_prefill: One worker envelope per actual Prefill batch, with producer head and sampler; schedule/output CPU scopes once. Producer token is discarded by the router.
stages.2_kv_and_consumer_token1: One receiver envelope per request. Includes consumer prepare, KV receive/install and consumer bypass head/sampler, ends after device sync. No extra consumer first-token, prepare, head or sampler fee is charged.
stages.3_consumer_tokens2_to128: Exactly 127 normal Decode rounds per request; worker envelope for the actual formed batch, plus its schedule/output CPU scopes. Does not charge token1 again.

resource_assumptions.worker: one opaque GPU permit for the entire synchronized host/device envelope; GPU can be idle inside this envelope
resource_assumptions.engine_cpu: existing per-replica CPU prepare/finish resources; schedule/output disjoint in profiling
resource_assumptions.receiver: existing transfer task holds source GPU, destination GPU and endpoints; serial per-request envelope; occupancy is an unvalidated approximation
resource_assumptions.internal_overlap: none inside a composite; host/device overlap within the measurement counted once
resource_assumptions.between_batches: existing scheduler and DAG resources unchanged

context_rule: Linear interpolation of uniform measured worker envelopes by actual mean context, separately by phase, input length and actual batch. No extrapolation. Mixed-context vector reduced to mean is a modelling approximation.
limitations: Synchronous offline profiling perturbs overlap; fee is an inclusive service envelope, not isolated kernel time.
Receiver measured serial with eight-output requests; used only through first token, independent of later output length.
Per-request receiver assumption omits shared first-token batch savings and may overestimate concurrent cost.
Consumer bypass engine schedule/output, router/routing/IPC/stream tail outside measured envelopes remain unmodelled residuals; no E2E-derived correction.
